name: @workspace/bugbounty-report-mcp
description: Local MCP server for deterministic bug bounty report templates, validation, and rendering.

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && tsc -p tsconfig.json --incremental false && find src/templates -type f -name '*.md' -exec sh -c 'for file do target="dist/${file#src/}"; mkdir -p "$(dirname "$target")"; cp "$file" "$target"; done' sh {} +
